headline: SELF-INDEX reports search and memory retrieval gains from revisable keys
summary: The authors of SELF-INDEX describe an optimizer that diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, revises document keys, validates changes and uses simulated queries. Their paper reports improvements across BRIGHT with three retrievers, BrowseComp-Plus across four backbones and LongMemEval V2. For GPT-OSS-120B with BM25, reported BrowseComp-Plus accuracy rises from 31.08% to 58.92% while search calls decrease. LongMemEval results vary by task: several improve by 9.2–13.9%, while Gotchas is unchanged or lower. These are paper-reported results; independent replication and matched full optimization-cost comparisons remain open.
